captured_on.note: The last machine the environment was captured on. check_env.py reports the live OS beside it; a different OS is a warning, not a failure.

ardupilot.note: The checkout at src/ardupilot is pinned to `commit` (the author's fork commit that carries the KangarooFollow tests, 2026-09-17). The parent repository's recorded gitlink may lag it; check_env.py reports both and pins to `commit`.

python.note: MAVProxy is a hard import of Tools/autotest/vehicle_test_suite.py, so a cell cannot be flown without it; check_env.py fails on its absence except under --dry-run. It was not installed on the capture machine (the dry run was).

location.name: SpringValley2
location.note: Spring Valley Farm (ANU), the flight site of Chapter 3 (fig:spring-valley-flight-area): the `SpringValley2` entry of Tools/autotest/locations.txt, 15 m from the home recorded in the 2026-07-18 flight log. The local frame is still anchored at the aircraft when the window opens (HANC); the site sets where the box and the take-off are. The SITL runs there at the author's direction (2026-09-17).

flight_area.note: ADR-012 (2026-10-07): the kangaroo is contained in the flight-test fence `fence_file`, a QGC WPL 110 convex inclusion polygon, in the SITL campaign, the demonstration and the hardware validation script. The planner converts it to North/East metres from the site's home with ArduPilot's own get_distance_NE formula, re-runs each Python counterpart contained against it in the aircraft's anchor frame, and the test uploads the file's vertices as the report-only fence (`fence_action` 0: a breach is logged, never acted on, TASK-046 D7). Grid cells open the window with the aircraft `anchor_offset_ne_m` from the fence's area centroid (250 m South; the kangaroo, 300 m North of the aircraft, starts 50 m North of it); composite cells anchor at the centroid and are fitted to the largest square there that the fence holds. Take-off and the window are flown at `alt_m` above home for `window_s`. Until 2026-10-07 the area was an axis-aligned 600 x 800 m box centred 337 m N, 183 m E of home (box_e_m, box_n_m, centre_offset_ne_m), still accepted when `fence_file` is absent.
